content.text: {"manual":[{"text":"THERMAL CONSOLE OPERATIONS","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.SubTitleText"},{"text":"Enabling outtake fans can help decrease the amount of pressure gained, or help level it off. Remember to disable outtake fans periodically when in State 1 to avoid stallout. Also remember to re-enable them in greater states as to avoid a high pressure warning.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"Overview - The Thermal Console is where core temperature and chamber pressure is primarily managed.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"Coolant Pumps or C-Pumps degrade at a constant rate due to the corrosive nature of ISE, and this is made worse based on the pump level. It's recommended you observe the reservior level and reactor chamber Coolant Pipes to guage how close it is to failing.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"When the core is in an Equinox State, pressure systems have been noted to be ineffective due to an as of yet unkown phenomena that affects several systems and components in the installation.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"Additionally, the C-Pumps have been observed degrading twice as fast as their usual rate, which at times ruptures or completely destroys the reactor's coolant network.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"TLDR: This console controls outtake fans and C-Pumps which help reduce the core's pressure and temperature. Higher coolant levels will cause them to degrade faster, necessitating more repairs.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TLDRLabel"},{"text":"Should the pumps fail, you are required to go in the heavy maintenance sub-sector, and make the appropriate repairs / recallibrations.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.ThermalConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"MAIN CONSOLE OPERATIONS","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.MainConsFrame.OperationsFrame.SubTitleText"},{"text":"E-VENTS or Emergency Ventilations are the large duct-like holes that surround the core. These are responsible for rapidly cooling down the core by ~ 7000F via a more pure and concentrated variant of Isotope E.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.MainConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"Atmosphere Ventilation is a less critical but still vital component of the reactor chamber. These are the vents that line the chamber walls, and are responsible for intaking a large amount of pressure in order to keep the reactor stable.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.MainConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"Overview - The Main Console contains important functions such as emergency systems like the E-Vents and Atmosphere Ventilation, as well as start-up Prerequisites like the Monitor Boot and Master Switch.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.MainConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"TLDR: This console controls E-Vents and atmosphere ventilation, as well as major start-up pre-requisites.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.MainConsFrame.OperationsFrame.TLDRLabel"},{"text":"START-UP PROCEDURES","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.StartupFrame.SubTitleText"},{"text":"MONITOR POWER > [ALT REACTOR CONSOLE]","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.StartupFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"CONTROL ROOM SHUTTERS > [ALT REACTOR CONSOLE]","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.StartupFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"MONITOR BOOT > [MAIN REACTOR CONSOLE]","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.StartupFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"NOTICE: ACTIVATE THE HDEF GENERATOR TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTROL ROOM RADIATION BREACH DURING START-UP. BE ADVISED THAT DURING REACTOR OPERATION, THE HDEF GENERATOR CAN OVERHEAT. PERIODICALLY SHUT IT OFF TO PREVENT OVERLOAD.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.StartupFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"FLIP MASTER SWITCH TO START-UP POSITION","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.StartupFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"REACTOR OPERATIONS GOAL","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.OperationsFrame.SubTitleText"},{"text":"Your exceptional qualifications and work performances has brought you to this job as an S0 Reactor Operator, and as such you have been granted access to some of the best equipment in the world (courtesy of Synthesis Manufacturing) in order to fulfill your new duties.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"As reactor operations personnel, you are required to Achieve the target energy quota, and sucessfully shut down the reactor each shift. You will be nickel and dimed for any company property damaged or destroyed in any way. Remaining funds can be used to invest in equipment to make your job easier.","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"},{"text":"Sucessfully completed shifts will reward you with greater access to the facility and potential for monetary benefits, however if the debt ceiling is reached, disciplinary action will occur. Good luck! The future of industry starts with you!","path":"Workspace.Consoles.ElectricGridConsole.DRMScreen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.BasicsFrame.OperationsFrame.TextLabel"}],"sources":{"StarterGui.ScreenGui.EndShiftHandler":"-- Saved by
